arguments.question: Given that the single retained execution reports terminal reach success (reach_passed=true; terminal_error_m≈0.00764 m within the 0.01 m reach tolerance) while sampled settling fails (sampled_settling_passed=false; late_max_speed_m_s≈1.581 and late_max_error_m≈0.058 against settling limits speed 0.02 m/s and position 0.01 m over a 0.05 s window), and all 35 retained control updates missed their DeadlineMissed horizons with mean_update_s≈17.08 s against a 0.01 s control period: which candidate local mechanisms are actually distinguishable using the retained per-update records (saved projected states, applied and requested tensions, one-step predictions, plan-selection iterations, effective horizon, solver status, and the sampled backend-motion view), and specifically — at the final saved projected states — can a bounded local_comparison of one adopted weight change, or a prediction_braking comparison of recorded input versus instantaneous braking-box input, separate objective weighting, seed/initialization selection, horizon truncation, or backend-model mismatch, or do these predict the same local result and leave the residual tip motion (speed vs position) unattributed? This is an open question; no dominant settling cause is assumed.
scope: Retained-evidence reads of the complete saved-record inventories for this execution (35 records each): source.saved_projected_states (/measured_initial_state), source.one_step_predictions (/one_step_prediction), source.applied_tensions (/actual_tension_n), source.plan_selection (/optimization_selected_iteration), source.solver_status (/optimization_raw_status), source.controller_horizon (/effective_horizon), plus the derived motion/plans/prediction views and the retained source.force_limits channel list.
The recovered common summary and inventory handoff (artifact e87b0e85...) already transferred to this design context, including the settling criteria, recipe weights, and outcome flags.

Explicitly authorized saved-state numerical work only: prediction_braking at one saved projected state over the fixed short bounded horizon, and local_comparison of two local controller solves at the same saved state/previous input/horizon with exactly one adopted weight change, using the host-supplied saved-state grant (horizon_s 0.01, integration_step_s 0.002, implicit_euler, model.gvs@1.0.0). These measure only local plan/endpoint differences at a saved state.

Excluded: any production configuration change, backend re-execution, closed-loop counterfactual replay, or causal-attribution claim; reconstruction of non-retained control_snapshots.json (full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces); any inference from a sampled view or a failed raw-gzip read that a signal is absent.

Distinguish availability states explicitly: not_displayed (present but not yet shown), not_read in this design context, queried with stated coverage, not_retained (control_snapshots.json), and retained_unavailable via a named capability.
stopping_conditions: All 35 retained records for each consulted signal are read once, or the read/turn allowance is exhausted, with coverage recorded per signal.
Any candidate local check is abandoned if it requires non-retained artifacts (full warm plans, optimizer iteration traces) or a closed-loop replay that the available capabilities do not provide.

If prediction_braking and/or local_comparison results cannot distinguish objective weighting, seed/initialization selection, effective-horizon truncation, or backend-model mismatch — i.e., they predict the same local endpoint — the ambiguity is recorded and no dominant settling cause is asserted.
No production change, backend execution, or configuration recommendation is emitted from this phase; only a scoped diagnostic question and the set of checkable retained comparisons.
If the required read allowance (evidence turn limit) closes before the scoped comparisons can be framed, stop and hand off with the unmet coverage stated.
